newsitem.title: USA: Planet Hollywood up on EPS, franchise pact.
newsitem.headline: Planet Hollywood up on EPS, franchise pact.

text.p: Plant Hollywood International Inc shares climbed to a higher orbit in busy trade Wednesday on news of the company's strong quarterly results and a key franchising agreement with a Saudi prince.

The primary force behind the stock's 17 percent climb, or 2-3/4 points, to 18-7/8 in afternoon Nasdaq trade was this morning's news of first-quarter earnings of $0.10 per share, traders and analysts said.
The earnings were $0.01 above Wall Street's consensus view, up from $0.04 per share one year ago, and helped higher by strong growth in merchandise sales, they said.
